## About Us

## " Embrace the Essence of China's Finest Distilled Spirit "

At JS International, we proudly serve as the exclusive importer of Yanghe Baijiu, introducing you to
the unparalleled world of this revered Chinese distilled liquor. As the gateway to this
extraordinary brand, we invite you to embark on a journey of taste and tradition.

Yanghe Baijiu stands as one of the most esteemed and popular Baijiu brands in China, capturing the
hearts of connoisseurs with its exceptional quality and rich heritage. Crafted with precision at the
renowned Yanghe Distillery since 1949, this esteemed establishment has perfected the art of Baijiu
production, earning accolades both domestically and internationally.
Renowned for its smooth and mellow flavor, distinguished by a captivating aroma and a long-lasting
aftertaste, Yanghe Baijiu embodies the epitome of refined craftsmanship. With a wide range of types
and grades available, including traditional clear spirits and aged varieties, Yanghe caters to
diverse tastes and preferences, ensuring a delightful experience for all.
Driven by a passion for excellence, Yanghe has expanded its reach beyond China, garnering admiration
and popularity in countries around the globe. At JS International, we take immense pride in bringing
the treasures of Yanghe Baijiu to discerning enthusiasts far and wide.
Beyond Baijiu, Yanghe Distillery has extended its expertise to areas such as wine production,
beverage distribution, and real estate development. This multifaceted enterprise exemplifies the
company’s commitment to growth and innovation within the alcohol industry.
With a strong presence and an unwavering dedication to quality, JS International remains at the
forefront of importing and distributing Yanghe Baijiu, ensuring that each sip is an unforgettable
experience. We invite you to explore the world of Yanghe Baijiu with us and savor the essence of
this remarkable Chinese spirit.
Indulge in the legacy, heritage, and extraordinary flavors of Yanghe Baijiu, exclusively offered
through JS International. Join us on this extraordinary journey as we continue to elevate the
standards of excellence in the world of Baijiu.

# Dream Blue 梦之蓝

## Dream Blue is our high-end series. Carrying on traditional craftsmanship and distilling
## techniques from ancient Yanghe, we use base liquor stored underground for centuries as flavoring,
## strictly controlling every step of the production process.

## Dream Blue is strong but not overpowering, gentle but not weak. The taste, bountiful and
## harmonious, unfolds slowly and ends with a clean finish. The flavour is exquisite and mellow with
## a long aftertaste. It is truly a masterpiece of China's mellow baijiu.

## About Us

## " Embrace the Essence of China's Finest Distilled Spirit "

At JS International, we proudly serve as the exclusive importer of Yanghe Baijiu, introducing you to
the unparalleled world of this revered Chinese distilled liquor. As the gateway to this
extraordinary brand, we invite you to embark on a journey of taste and tradition.

Yanghe Baijiu stands as one of the most esteemed and popular Baijiu brands in China, capturing the
hearts of connoisseurs with its exceptional quality and rich heritage. Crafted with precision at the
renowned Yanghe Distillery since 1949, this esteemed establishment has perfected the art of Baijiu
production, earning accolades both domestically and internationally.
Renowned for its smooth and mellow flavor, distinguished by a captivating aroma and a long-lasting
aftertaste, Yanghe Baijiu embodies the epitome of refined craftsmanship. With a wide range of types
and grades available, including traditional clear spirits and aged varieties, Yanghe caters to
diverse tastes and preferences, ensuring a delightful experience for all.
Driven by a passion for excellence, Yanghe has expanded its reach beyond China, garnering admiration
and popularity in countries around the globe. At JS International, we take immense pride in bringing
the treasures of Yanghe Baijiu to discerning enthusiasts far and wide.
Beyond Baijiu, Yanghe Distillery has extended its expertise to areas such as wine production,
beverage distribution, and real estate development. This multifaceted enterprise exemplifies the
company’s commitment to growth and innovation within the alcohol industry.
With a strong presence and an unwavering dedication to quality, JS International remains at the
forefront of importing and distributing Yanghe Baijiu, ensuring that each sip is an unforgettable
experience. We invite you to explore the world of Yanghe Baijiu with us and savor the essence of
this remarkable Chinese spirit.
Indulge in the legacy, heritage, and extraordinary flavors of Yanghe Baijiu, exclusively offered
through JS International. Join us on this extraordinary journey as we continue to elevate the
standards of excellence in the world of Baijiu.

# Dream Blue 梦之蓝

## Dream Blue is our high-end series. Carrying on traditional craftsmanship and distilling
## techniques from ancient Yanghe, we use base liquor stored underground for centuries as flavoring,
## strictly controlling every step of the production process.

## Dream Blue is strong but not overpowering, gentle but not weak. The taste, bountiful and
## harmonious, unfolds slowly and ends with a clean finish. The flavour is exquisite and mellow with
## a long aftertaste. It is truly a masterpiece of China's mellow baijiu.

## Why Laurus Bio?

Laurus Bio is an integrated research-driven biomanufacturing organization with deep expertise in
precision fermentation and recombinant technology. We engineer microbes as “cell-factories” to
manufacture novel and sustainable animal-free proteins and growth factors that replace
animal-derived products in biopharma, food, health, nutrition, and personal care markets.

#### Commitment to Quality

#### Commitment to Quality

At Laurus Bio, quality is a way of life. Our advanced quality management systems and experienced
teams help us meet the highest global quality and regulatory standards. The seals of approval from
ISO, cGMP, FSSC 22000, Kosher, and Halal are a testament to our commitment to superior quality.

#### Customer-Centric Innovation

#### Customer-Centric Innovation

We are an innovation-led biotechnology company, with customer needs at the core of our R&D process.
Our vision and commitment to develop sustainable products and services motivates us to address the
needs and pain-points of industries such as Biopharma, Health, Food, Alternative and Novel Protein,
and White Biotechnology.

#### Research and Manufacturing Capabilities

#### Research and Manufacturing Capabilities

We take pride in our state-of-the-art R&D capabilities and cGMP-certified manufacturing facility.
Combining science, scale, and flexibility, we strive to exceed expectations and become the partner
of choice for our customers.

#### Location and Ecosystem

#### Location and Ecosystem

We are based in Bengaluru, the biomanufacturing hub of India that gives us access to rich talent and
a reliable supply of raw materials. Our location helps us benefit from a thriving ecosystem that
encourages advanced R&D and manufacturing in biotechnology.

## Animal-Origin-Free Solutions

Our animal-origin-free (AOF) recombinant proteins, growth factors, and cell-culture media
supplements enhance safety, lot-to-lot consistency, traceability, and competitiveness. Our
wide-ranging solutions, developed by our team of experts, cater to the needs of various industries
such as:

## Microbial Precision Fermentation CDMO and Scale-Up Services

At Laurus Bio, we offer precision fermentation expertise as a service to our customers engaged in
microbial fermentation-based manufacturing and product development. Whether it is in clone
development, strain engineering, fermentation scale-up (from R&D/bench-scale to pilot-scale), or
large-scale commercial manufacturing — we help throughout the precision fermentation value chain, at
every step of our customers’ journey.

## Why Laurus Bio?

Laurus Bio is an integrated research-driven biomanufacturing organization with deep expertise in
precision fermentation and recombinant technology. We engineer microbes as “cell-factories” to
manufacture novel and sustainable animal-free proteins and growth factors that replace
animal-derived products in biopharma, food, health, nutrition, and personal care markets.

#### Commitment to Quality

#### Commitment to Quality

At Laurus Bio, quality is a way of life. Our advanced quality management systems and experienced
teams help us meet the highest global quality and regulatory standards. The seals of approval from
ISO, cGMP, FSSC 22000, Kosher, and Halal are a testament to our commitment to superior quality.

#### Customer-Centric Innovation

#### Customer-Centric Innovation

We are an innovation-led biotechnology company, with customer needs at the core of our R&D process.
Our vision and commitment to develop sustainable products and services motivates us to address the
needs and pain-points of industries such as Biopharma, Health, Food, Alternative and Novel Protein,
and White Biotechnology.

#### Research and Manufacturing Capabilities

#### Research and Manufacturing Capabilities

We take pride in our state-of-the-art R&D capabilities and cGMP-certified manufacturing facility.
Combining science, scale, and flexibility, we strive to exceed expectations and become the partner
of choice for our customers.

#### Location and Ecosystem

#### Location and Ecosystem

We are based in Bengaluru, the biomanufacturing hub of India that gives us access to rich talent and
a reliable supply of raw materials. Our location helps us benefit from a thriving ecosystem that
encourages advanced R&D and manufacturing in biotechnology.

## Animal-Origin-Free Solutions

Our animal-origin-free (AOF) recombinant proteins, growth factors, and cell-culture media
supplements enhance safety, lot-to-lot consistency, traceability, and competitiveness. Our
wide-ranging solutions, developed by our team of experts, cater to the needs of various industries
such as:

At Laurus Bio, we offer precision fermentation expertise as a service to our customers engaged in
microbial fermentation-based manufacturing and product development. Whether it is in clone
development, strain engineering, fermentation scale-up (from R&D/bench-scale to pilot-scale), or
large-scale commercial manufacturing — we help throughout the precision fermentation value chain, at

## The best meal of your trip is down an alley you'd never find on your own.

### The best local spots are hard to find.

The places locals love don’t have English menus and barely show up online, but they've been feeding
the neighborhood for generations.

### Your time is too valuable to waste.

You only have a few days and the risk is real. It's leaving with a checklist of tourist destinations
but never feeling like you actually got inside the city.

### A great meal always comes with a story.

You remember more than the food. You remember who made it, how long they've been doing it, and why
that dish matters here.

## The best meal of your trip is down an alley you'd never find on your own.

### The best local spots are hard to find.

The places locals love don’t have English menus and barely show up online, but they've been feeding
the neighborhood for generations.

### Your time is too valuable to waste.

You only have a few days and the risk is real. It's leaving with a checklist of tourist destinations
but never feeling like you actually got inside the city.

### A great meal always comes with a story.

You remember more than the food. You remember who made it, how long they've been doing it, and why
that dish matters here.

## OUR BAIJIU

Ming River is an award-winning baijiu crafted at China's oldest distillery, Luzhou Laojiao,
established in 1573.

A traditional baijiu made from locally harvested sorghum grain, Ming River is notable for its
complexity and robust body. The Ming River brand was established to champion universal appreciation
of baijiu through culture, community and cocktails. 

[Ming River Sorghum Mood.]
[READ MORE ABOUT OUR PRODUCT ][12]

## ABOUT BAIJIU

## Baijiu pronounced bye-j’yo, meaning “white spirits” in Mandarin—is a category that encompasses
## all traditional Chinese grain spirits. Baijiu is most commonly distilled from sorghum, but is
## also often made from rice, wheat, corn and millet. Baijiu production techniques differ
## significantly by region and style, and different styles of baijiu can be as distinct as whiskey
## is to tequila.

[Baijiu From The Still]
[READ MORE ABOUT BAIJIU ][13]

## THE DISTILLERY

The Luzhou Laojiao baijiu distillery invented the “Sichuan baijiu” style. Started in 1573, and using
techniques inspired by a local tradition that spans two thousand years, it is the oldest continually
operating distillery in China.

## OUR BAIJIU

Ming River is an award-winning baijiu crafted at China's oldest distillery, Luzhou Laojiao,
established in 1573.

A traditional baijiu made from locally harvested sorghum grain, Ming River is notable for its
complexity and robust body. The Ming River brand was established to champion universal appreciation
of baijiu through culture, community and cocktails. 

[Ming River Sorghum Mood.]
[READ MORE ABOUT OUR PRODUCT ][12]

## ABOUT BAIJIU

## Baijiu pronounced bye-j’yo, meaning “white spirits” in Mandarin—is a category that encompasses
## all traditional Chinese grain spirits. Baijiu is most commonly distilled from sorghum, but is
## also often made from rice, wheat, corn and millet. Baijiu production techniques differ
## significantly by region and style, and different styles of baijiu can be as distinct as whiskey
## is to tequila.

[Baijiu From The Still]
[READ MORE ABOUT BAIJIU ][13]

## THE DISTILLERY

The Luzhou Laojiao baijiu distillery invented the “Sichuan baijiu” style. Started in 1573, and using
techniques inspired by a local tradition that spans two thousand years, it is the oldest continually
operating distillery in China.

central hub for your brand online. Our web design and development services focus on creating digital
experiences that foster deep emotional engagement with your brand. We craft visually stunning and
intuitive websites that reflect your brand's identity, and also optimize UX for engagement and
conversion.

We develop specialized web applications designed to enhance the experience of distributors and
accounts, streamlining interactions and improving efficiency. Our goal is to develop a comprehensive
digital platform that supports your marketing efforts and strengthens your brand's online
visibility, ensuring a seamless connection with both consumers and trade partners.

**07**

## motion design

[
Product Rendering
][54]
[
3D Animation
][55]
[
3D Commercials
][56]

Our 3D motion design services transform standard marketing into a captivating visual experience. We
specialize in crafting 3D commercials that are not only eye-catching but also foster deep emotional
engagement with your brand. These visually stunning animations go beyond driving immediate sales;
they are strategic tools designed to build and enhance your brand image.

By focusing on emotional connections rather than transactional interactions, our 3D commercials help
establish a strong alcohol brand presence that resonates with audiences. We believe that consumers
are drawn to brands that engage them on an emotional level, choosing to buy because of the
relationship and trust built, not merely because of discounts or promotions.

**08**

## creative advertising

[
Outdoor & OOH Advertising
][57]
[
Online Advertising
][58]

In today's saturated alcohol market, claiming exceptional flavor or a storied brand history is no
longer sufficient. We understand that every brand boasts these qualities, but to truly capture
consumer attention, you must stand out. We push beyond conventional visual and verbal communication
to craft unique, memorable campaigns that break through the market compression.

We focus on innovative strategies that differentiate your alcohol brand from the crowd, ensuring it
not only gets noticed but also remembered. By employing creative storytelling, integrating our photo
and video production team, and crafting engaging content, we highlight what makes your brand unique
in ways that resonate deeply with consumers.

**09**

## conversion optimization

SMM Optimization

[

OhBEV enhances your digital touchpoints, whether it’s through your own website or third-party
platforms like Uber Eats or Drizly. We meticulously build and refine conversion funnels using
cutting-edge martech tools like Optimizely and Hotjar.

Our approach is structured around the P.I.E. framework for Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO),
focusing on Potential, Importance, and Ease to maximize effectiveness. This strategy ensures that we
attract visitors and also convert them into loyal customers, optimizing interactions to boost your
return on investment and strengthen your market presence.

go-to-market strategies, we offer tailored guidance that aligns with your long-term growth
objectives.

Whether you're launching in a new market, optimizing distribution channels, or ensuring regulatory
compliance, our consulting expertise empowers you with the insights and frameworks needed to
navigate challenges effectively. With deep industry knowledge and a data-driven approach, we equip

# Your Trusted Partner in Probiotics

We don't just manufacture probiotics—we collaborate to build solutions. With GMP-certified
facilities and a flexible approach, we bring your product vision to life.

[[Contract Fermentation]

### Contract Fermentation

From pilot projects to global supply.

Scalable, controlled fermentation for probiotic lactic acid-producing bacteria. We combine
flexibility, data-backed precision, and cGMP compliance to deliver consistent, high-quality results
at any scale—from 250L to 5,000L vessels.

Learn More
][10][[Contract Manufacturing]

### Contract Manufacturing

Every product meets the highest standards.

Full-service probiotic manufacturing from formulation to packaging. Custom blending, encapsulation,
and private-label solutions—all under one roof with cGMP and SafeFeed/SafeFood certification at
every stage.

Learn More
][11][[Research & Development]

### Research & Development

Backed by data, guided by science.

Our in-house R&D team combines whole genome sequencing, metabolic assays, and benchtop fermentation
to accelerate probiotic innovation. From strain screening to stability studies, we turn scientific
insight into scalable solutions.

Learn More
][12]
[Bulk probiotic manufacturing and production]

## Bulk Probiotic Solutions

GUANGDONG SHIWAN WINE GROUP CO., LTD
      Guangdong Shiwan Wine Group Co, Ltd. is a professional Baijiu industry group headquartered in
ShiwanTown,Chancheng District,Foshan City.Its predecessor was the "Taiji Chen distillery" founded in
the Daoguang Decade of the Qing Dynasty (1830). "Taiji Chen distillery" is located at Zhuzi Street,
Shiwan, which is currently No. 106 Taiping Street. It has a history of 190 years. It is a
long-established Chinese brand that is still produced on the original site in Guangdong. It is
well-known for its excellent brewing of pure grain wine。
      The production capacity of the group reaches 100,000 tons, and it has passed the ISO9001
international quality system certification and HACCP system certification. It is the drafting unit
of the national standard of "Soy-Flavor baijiu" and the secretariat unit of the National Soy flavor
Liquor Sub-Committee. The group is the“Top 100 Liquor Enterprises”and "AAA enterprise credit
evaluation”in china。
      The leading product, Shiwan Yu bing shao, has successively won the titles of National
high-quality Liquor in 1984, Chinese Liquor Soy-flavor Representative Products in 2006, and has been
approved as a National Geographical Symbol Protection Product in 2015. It is a representative liquor
in Guangdong with three national reputation. It has been sold overseas as early as 1917, it has been
loved and recognized by international consumers for more than 100 years。

GUANGDONG SHIWAN WINE GROUP CO., LTD
      Guangdong Shiwan Wine Group Co, Ltd. is a professional Baijiu industry group headquartered in
ShiwanTown,Chancheng District,Foshan City.Its predecessor was the "Taiji Chen distillery" founded in
the Daoguang Decade of the Qing Dynasty (1830). "Taiji Chen distillery" is located at Zhuzi Street,
Shiwan, which is currently No. 106 Taiping Street. It has a history of 190 years. It is a
long-established Chinese brand that is still produced on the original site in Guangdong. It is
well-known for its excellent brewing of pure grain wine。
      The production capacity of the group reaches 100,000 tons, and it has passed the ISO9001
international quality system certification and HACCP system certification. It is the drafting unit
of the national standard of "Soy-Flavor baijiu" and the secretariat unit of the National Soy flavor
Liquor Sub-Committee. The group is the“Top 100 Liquor Enterprises”and "AAA enterprise credit
evaluation”in china。
      The leading product, Shiwan Yu bing shao, has successively won the titles of National
high-quality Liquor in 1984, Chinese Liquor Soy-flavor Representative Products in 2006, and has been
approved as a National Geographical Symbol Protection Product in 2015. It is a representative liquor
in Guangdong with three national reputation. It has been sold overseas as early as 1917, it has been
loved and recognized by international consumers for more than 100 years。

## Kweichow Moutai

贵州茅台酒是中国的传统特产酒。与苏格兰威士忌、法国科涅克白兰地齐名的世界三大蒸馏名酒之一，同时是中国
三大名酒“茅五剑”之一。也是大曲酱香型白酒的鼻祖，已有800多年的历史。

The most revered spirit in China and #1 most valuable spirits brand worldwide.

[SHOP MOUTAI][9]

## Luzhou Laojiao

泸州老窖酒传统酿造技艺，始于秦汉，经元、明、清三朝而创制、定性、成熟，历二十四代传人，持续传承六百九
十余年。

One of the oldest distilleries in China, established in 1573.

## Wu Liang Ye

五粮液酒具有
“香气悠久、味醇厚、入口甘美、入喉净爽、各味谐调、恰到好处、酒味全面”的独特风格，是浓香型白酒中的经典
之作。

Strong Aroma Baijiu from Sichuan and the leading brand in the category.

## Xi Feng

每一滴西凤酒都是时间与传统工艺的完美演绎。

From Xian, the hometown of terracotta soldiers and original capital of China.

## Kweichow Moutai

贵州茅台酒是中国的传统特产酒。与苏格兰威士忌、法国科涅克白兰地齐名的世界三大蒸馏名酒之一，同时是中国
三大名酒“茅五剑”之一。也是大曲酱香型白酒的鼻祖，已有800多年的历史。

The most revered spirit in China and #1 most valuable spirits brand worldwide.

[SHOP MOUTAI][9]

## Luzhou Laojiao

泸州老窖酒传统酿造技艺，始于秦汉，经元、明、清三朝而创制、定性、成熟，历二十四代传人，持续传承六百九
十余年。

One of the oldest distilleries in China, established in 1573.

## Wu Liang Ye

五粮液酒具有
“香气悠久、味醇厚、入口甘美、入喉净爽、各味谐调、恰到好处、酒味全面”的独特风格，是浓香型白酒中的经典
之作。

Strong Aroma Baijiu from Sichuan and the leading brand in the category.

## Xi Feng

每一滴西凤酒都是时间与传统工艺的完美演绎。

From Xian, the hometown of terracotta soldiers and original capital of China.

#### Types of Alcohol
* **Liquor** (also distilled alcohol) is an alcoholic drink produced by the distillation of grains,
  fruits, or vegetables that have already gone through alcoholic fermentation. The distillation
  process purifies the liquid to increase its alcohol by volume. As liquors contain significantly
  more alcohol (ethanol) than other alcoholic drinks, they are considered “harder” – in North
  America, the term hard liquor is used to distinguish distilled alcoholic drinks from non-distilled
  ones, whereas the term spirits are used in the UK. Examples of liquors include brandy, vodka,
  baijiu, shōchū, soju, gin, rum, tequila, mezcal, and whisky. [Wikipedia][301]

# About WBD 世界白酒节

# For places to enjoy baijiu,
# click [here][20].

**World Baijiu Day** features a spirit more common than vodka, whiskey or rum, but little known
beyond China. Baijiu is a potent grain spirit, typically with a 53% kick, that represents about a
third of global hard liquor production.

China makes the vast majority of baijiu, about 10 billion liters per year on average, enough to fill
4,000 Olympic-sized pools. That much baijiu poured into shot glasses and stacked would reach the
moon.

Interest in baijiu is slowly growing around the world, with this spirit popping up in booze shops,
bars and restaurants, and a small number of producers trying their hand at making baijiu.

World Baijiu Day aims to make this spirit better known. Since the first WBD in 2015, partners in
70-plus cities have held events—from Melbourne to Minsk, Stockholm to Singapore, Los Angeles to
Lima—each August 9. The numbers for August 9 are ‘ba’ and ‘jiu’ in Mandarin and sound close to
baijiu.

World Baijiu Day photos from around the world.

Pronounced ‘bye joe”, baijiu translates to “white alcohol” and uses production techniques with roots
thousands of years old. (Alcohol has been produced in China for at least 8,000 years.)

Bajjiu is drunk as warm straight shots to the toast of ‘ganbei” or ‘dry glass’ (‘bottoms up’). As
this isn’t common in many nations, a World Baijiu Day theme is ‘beyond ganbei’. Partners have been
creative in making baijiu-inspired [cocktails][21], [infusions][22], [liqueurs][23],
[chocolate][24], [pizza][25] and [more][26]. Even [deep-fried baijiu][27].

Baijiu cocktails at Compass Bar in Shenzhen.

Learn more about WBD and about how baijiu is made [here][28]. And about this year’s events
[here][29]. If you are interested in doing an event, you just need a place, some baijiu and a bit of
creativity! Let us know at *spirit (at) worldbaijiuday.com* or through our [Instagram][30] or
[Facebook][31] pages so we can spread the word!

Finally, World Baijiu Day doesn’t aim to convince everyone to become a baijiu lover. The goal is to
give people the chance to try one of the planet’s most intriguing spirits. And for those who have
tried baijiu and didn’t like it, maybe due to heavy ‘ganbei’ (bottoms up) sessions, a chance to give
it another try. It’s also a reason to get creative and have fun!

Cheers, Jim Boyce

Get in touch with via spirit@worldbaijiuday.com. Follow us on [Facebook][32], [Twitter][33] and
[Instagram][34]. I also run wine sites [Grape Wall of China][35] and [World Marselan Day][36].

# About WBD 世界白酒节

# For places to enjoy baijiu,
# click [here][20].

**World Baijiu Day** features a spirit more common than vodka, whiskey or rum, but little known
beyond China. Baijiu is a potent grain spirit, typically with a 53% kick, that represents about a
third of global hard liquor production.

China makes the vast majority of baijiu, about 10 billion liters per year on average, enough to fill
4,000 Olympic-sized pools. That much baijiu poured into shot glasses and stacked would reach the
moon.

Interest in baijiu is slowly growing around the world, with this spirit popping up in booze shops,
bars and restaurants, and a small number of producers trying their hand at making baijiu.

World Baijiu Day aims to make this spirit better known. Since the first WBD in 2015, partners in
70-plus cities have held events—from Melbourne to Minsk, Stockholm to Singapore, Los Angeles to
Lima—each August 9. The numbers for August 9 are ‘ba’ and ‘jiu’ in Mandarin and sound close to
baijiu.

World Baijiu Day photos from around the world.

Pronounced ‘bye joe”, baijiu translates to “white alcohol” and uses production techniques with roots
thousands of years old. (Alcohol has been produced in China for at least 8,000 years.)

Bajjiu is drunk as warm straight shots to the toast of ‘ganbei” or ‘dry glass’ (‘bottoms up’). As
this isn’t common in many nations, a World Baijiu Day theme is ‘beyond ganbei’. Partners have been
creative in making baijiu-inspired [cocktails][21], [infusions][22], [liqueurs][23],
[chocolate][24], [pizza][25] and [more][26]. Even [deep-fried baijiu][27].

Baijiu cocktails at Compass Bar in Shenzhen.

Learn more about WBD and about how baijiu is made [here][28]. And about this year’s events
[here][29]. If you are interested in doing an event, you just need a place, some baijiu and a bit of
creativity! Let us know at *spirit (at) worldbaijiuday.com* or through our [Instagram][30] or
[Facebook][31] pages so we can spread the word!

Finally, World Baijiu Day doesn’t aim to convince everyone to become a baijiu lover. The goal is to
give people the chance to try one of the planet’s most intriguing spirits. And for those who have
tried baijiu and didn’t like it, maybe due to heavy ‘ganbei’ (bottoms up) sessions, a chance to give
it another try. It’s also a reason to get creative and have fun!

Cheers, Jim Boyce

Get in touch with via spirit@worldbaijiuday.com. Follow us on [Facebook][32], [Twitter][33] and
[Instagram][34]. I also run wine sites [Grape Wall of China][35] and [World Marselan Day][36].
